p.s: I disagree with that in twenty years there will be fewer cars in use than there are today.

there is a big population in both of the two country.

Espectially in usa, the USA is so wide that people live in there ca n't leave from cars.

Of course not!
Everybody need the space of himself.

there wo n't be fewer cars in use than there are today i think.
